_doc: Service-area photo cards: the frames (photos) and which frames an area card may show, in order of preference.

Every alt describes the photo, never the card's area: a card labelled Aurora that shows geese says geese. Only denver-skyline is a recognisable photo of its place; every other banner was supplied with the site under a city's file name and is unconfirmed, so it is described, never claimed.

match: exact = a photo of the place; within = a photo of Denver on a Denver neighborhood card; own-banner = the banner the site supplied for that city (unconfirmed); regional = a generic Front Range / suburban scene with no landmark.
ownOnly frames (a specific building or object) are only ever shown for their own city, never as a generic scene.
blocks: the original link list of every area block (October 2026), the candidates the tool picks from; the tool adds same-region areas so every city page keeps inbound card links.
No new city photos were uploaded with the October 2026 port; add a frame (source under assets/, honest alt), point the area at it first and re-run node tools/apply-area-cards.mjs.
